en: Someone broke the old blue vase this morning. And one person in this house is lying.
It had been raining since sunrise. Heavy rain. All morning.
Person 1 says: I was reading in the garden the whole time.
Person 2 says: I was in the kitchen, baking bread.
Person 3 says: I was asleep upstairs. I only woke up when I heard the crash.
Look closely. One of them just gave themselves away.
Who is lying? Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
